headline: Police CTD said on Sunday that three Pakistani Taliban militants were killed in an intelligence-based operation in Matni area of Peshawar, while a quadcopter attack on a jirga in Bannu injured 10 people, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Bannu mein quadcopter hamle mein 10 log zakhmi

caption:
Peshawar mein CTD ka operation, 3 dehshatgard halak! 📌
Arab News ke mutabiq police ke counter-terrorism department (CTD) ne Sunday ko bataya ke Peshawar ke ilaqe Matni mein intelligence ki bunyaad par kiye gaye operation mein Pakistani Taliban se wabasta 3 dehshatgard halak ho gaye. CTD ke mutabiq yeh sarkari imaraton par hamle ki mansooba bandi kar rahe the, aur faraar saathiyon ki talash jari hai. Ek alag waqiye mein Bannu mein ek jirga par quadcopter se hamla hua jis mein 10 log zakhmi hue. Hospital ke mutabiq sab zakhmi khatre se bahar hain.
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa mein aman ke liye aap ke khayal mein sab se zaroori qadam kya hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
